parentAssessment.outcome: Both arms accept the legitimate local subsection and leave the incomplete group capability OPEN. Both retain authorization/source/recovery/storage/route limitations. No measured advantage for the additional table instruction.
parentAssessment.semanticChecks: Read complete claims and next actions against the pre-dispatch expectation table. Topic labels may say SUPPORTED for an observed limitation or INCONCLUSIVE for an absent acceptance; grade actual assertion, not label alone.
parentAssessment.scope: Two synthetic acceptance-report tasks, one fresh run per arm. No production coding, browser, human comparison or general reliability estimate.
limitations: Prompts require identical JSON claim fields in both arms, so treatment tests explicit contradiction attention, not table versus prose.
No-tool boundary was procedural; tools remained technically available. No candidate tool call was observed.
No measured token or latency comparison.
Expected conclusions were frozen in parent memory before dispatch; the executable record checker and calibration were written afterward, before adoption.

retrospectiveErrata.correction: The fixture includes preservation, not a migration requirement. Migration was not graded; the original expectation is retained as evidence of this wording defect.
The fixture establishes substantial measured growth and no enforced lifetime cap; it does not prove unlimited future growth. Graded conclusion: bounded lifetime storage is not established.
No file contents were supplied and no file/tool reads were observed. Shared filesystem/tools remained technically accessible; no isolation guarantee is made. Frozen protocol hash retained.

independentGrade.context: fork_turns:none; factual packet only, no arm mapping, parent verdict or other review
limits: Fixtures explicitly state decisive facts: this tests extraction/acceptance calibration, not independent repository investigation.
Safe rejection, successful recovery and unsafe behavior are different claims.
Uninterrupted journey, lifetime cap, human testing and distributed devices were not extra undisclosed blockers.
